content.title: Subsea7 Secures Major Decommissioning Project in the North Sea
content.summary: SUBCY wins a sizeable North Sea contract from Ithaca Energy, taking on decommissioning work for key offshore assets, with operations starting in 2026.

content.title: Petrobras Discloses Revised 2026-2030 Investment Plan of $109B
content.summary: PBR cuts its 2026-2030 budget by 2% while boosting pre-salt investment, targeting higher production and advancing new energy and sustainability projects.

content.title: Why Fast-paced Mover Oceaneering International (OII) Is a Great Choice for Value Investors
content.summary: Oceaneering International (OII) could be a great choice for investors looking to buy stocks that have gained strong momentum recently but are still trading at reasonable prices. It is one of the several stocks that made it through our 'Fast-Paced Momentum at a Bargain' screen.

content.title: Shell Partners With ADES for Major Offshore Drilling Contract
content.summary: SHEL deepens its Southeast Asia presence as Brunei Shell Petroleum awards ADES a major offshore drilling contract in Brunei.

content.title: Venture Global Expands LNG Supply to Japan With Tokyo Gas Deal
content.summary: VG inks a 20-year LNG supply deal with Tokyo Gas, expanding its Japan footprint as long-term offtake agreements accelerate.

content.title: Petrobras Likely to Trim Capex Plan as Market Faces Weak Oil Prices
content.summary: PBR will reportedly trim its five-year spending plan as falling oil prices push it to boost efficiency and focus on higher-output assets.

content.title: Shell Signs Long-Term Renewable Energy Deal With Ferrari
content.summary: SHEL's long-term renewable energy deal with Ferrari aims to cut emissions and power nearly half of the automaker's Maranello plant through 2034.

content.title: BP's Olympic Pipeline Shutdown Impacts Refined Product Supplies
content.summary: BP's pipeline leak forces a shutdown of its Olympic system, tightening jet fuel supplies at the Seattle-Tacoma airport.

content.title: XOM Halts Plans for Massive Blue Hydrogen Plant Amid Weak Demand
content.summary: ExxonMobil halts its Baytown blue hydrogen project as weak demand and higher costs stall progress, and future plans hinge on stronger interest.

content.title: Petrobras to Delay Drilling Contracts Due to Global Oil Surplus
content.summary: PBR reportedly delays key Buzios' drilling contracts to 2026 as it navigates a shifting oil market and pushes for more cost-efficient offshore growth.
